title: Bus tera intezaar
body:
BAS TERA INTEZAAR HAI MAULA BAS TERA INTEZAAR HAI X2
MUSTARIB HAI YEH CHAAHNE WAALE AUR LAB PAR PUKAR HAI MAULA
SARRI DUNIYA KO AMN SE BHARDE, SAB HATTA (DE HIJAAB AUR PARDE) INTEZAAR KE PARDE
JO ADHURA HAI AAJ THAK MAULA, KAAM PURRA WO AAJ TU KARDE
MUNTAKIM TU HAI KHOON E NA HAQ KA, WAARIS E ZULFIKAR HAI MAULA
WAARI SE TAGH AUR ALAM TU HAI MISLE KARAAR MOHTARAM TU HAI
KYU NA TUJKO PUKAREH YEH DUNIYA HASHIMI KHOON KA BHARAM TU HAI
ZULM KI SALTANAT MITAYEGA YEH HUMMEH EHTEHBAAR HAI MAULA
KARBALA KE TEMAAM SHOHDA KA HEY TUHI EHTEBAAR ZEHRA KA
TERE AANAA KA WAQT AAYA HAI DEKHLE HAAL SAARI DUNIYA KA
ZULM SEHNE SE PURSAA DAARO KA DEKH KYA HAAL E ZAAR HAI MAULA
APNI HIMMAT KO AAZMANA HAI ANDHIYO MEI DIYAA JALAANA HAI
CHAAHE JAISA BHI WAQT AAJAAEH ZIKR E SHABIR THO MANANA HAI
TERE LASHKAR MEI SIRF HUM HI NAHI SAATH PARWARDIGAR HAI MAULA
TERE HAAMI HAI KHUD JANAB E AMIR SAB TAWANGAR HAI JISKE DARKE FAQIR
QARZ TUJPAR HAI AUR HUMPAR BHI ROZA E SEYYEDA KARE TAAMIR
AUR KUCH MAKSADE HAYAAT NAHI AUR NAA DUNIYA SE PYAR HAI MAULA
YEH MUSALMAAN BHI AMAL HOKAR LAR RAHE HAI NAMAZ O ROZA PAR
AAKEH TUHI SAMBHAL SAARA NEZAAM PHIRKA WERAANA JANG ROKH MAGAR
DEEN E ISLAM AUR SHARIAT PAR TERA HI EHTIYAAR HAI MAULA
TU BATAA MAQSADE HUSSEIN THA KYA KYU WATAN CHORKE CHALE MAULA
KYU SAKINA NE ZULM JALLE TH KYU HARAM NE LUTTA DIYA PARDA
AAKE MIMBAR SAMBHAAL MAJLIS KA YE JEHA (N) SOGAWAAR HAI MAULA
HEY NIGAAHO MEI DAST KA MANZAR CHAAR JAANIB HEY LAASH E BESAR
TERA ZARBO SE SHIMR NE KAATA EK MASLOOM BEWATAN KA SAR
TERA NAUHA SOUNE GE EHLE AZAA ILTEJAA BAAR BAAR HAI MAULA
HEY DUA MAZAR ABIDI MERI FATEMAH NAUHA KHAWN BANE EHSI
ISKA PEYGAAM DOUR THAK JAAYE PHIR FIZZA O MEI HO SEDAA YEHI
SAARI DUNIYA KI TU ZAROORAT HAI BAS TERA INTEZAAR HAI MAULA
